summary: VertexAIBackend is deprecated in favor of the new AgentPlatformBackend, whose default location is global instead of us-central1.
initializeAppCheck() must again be given a provider; the provider-less call added in 12.15.0 is removed.
In Node, Firestore's HTTP/2 flow-control window defaults to 256 KB instead of 64 KB (new grpcFlowControlWindow setting to change it).
All Imagen APIs are removed from firebase/ai (getImagenModel, getTemplateImagenModel, ImagenModel, TemplateImagenModel and the Imagen* config/response/enum types); use Gemini image models instead.
FunctionsError from callable functions includes the HTTP status code in its message and the request URL in customData, changing the message text for the same failure.

Storage and persistence errors during Auth current-user updates are wrapped in a FirebaseError with code auth/internal-error (original under customData.originalError) instead of propagating the raw exception.

TemplateGenerativeModel.generateContent()/generateContentStream() take a single TemplateRequest object ({ templateId, templateVariables, toolConfig? }) instead of separate templateId and variables arguments, and templateVariables is required in TemplateRequest and StartTemplateChatParams.
VertexAIBackend and BackendType.VERTEX_AI are removed; use AgentPlatformBackend (default location global; pass 'us-central1' to keep the old one).

Other long-deprecated AI Logic APIs are removed: AI.location, LiveSession.sendMediaChunks()/sendMediaStream(), LanguageModelCreateCoreOptions.topK/temperature, GoogleMaps.enableWidget, GroundingMetadata.retrievalQueries and CountTokensResponse.totalBillableCharacters.
The default in-cloud model for hybrid inference changes from gemini-2.5-flash-lite to gemini-3.5-flash-lite.
AI Part types become a discriminated union with an explicit type property (plus UnknownPart), type discriminators are stripped before sending, and chat history is deep-copied.
firebase/ai exports ChatSession as an interface instead of a class, so it can no longer be constructed or used as a value.
candidateCount, temperature, topP, topK, presencePenalty and frequencyPenalty are deprecated in GenerationConfig and LiveGenerationConfig.
The minimum supported Node.js version is 24.12.0 (engines in all @firebase packages), up from 20.
Firestore's UpdateData<T> type changes to accept indexed types and Record<X, T> for T (commit marked breaking).
